text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,387.4, up 0.38% on the day and 1.37% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.29% (1.08% five‑day). Advances outpaced declines (255 vs 234) giving a breadth score of 74.1, labelled “HEALTHY”. The Bank Nifty led the rally, gaining 1.13% (4.24% five‑day) to 62,273.25. Volatility eased, with the India VIX falling 1.02% to 15.52.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) added INR 4,195.38 cr today, extending a 14‑day buying streak and contributing to a net long‑short futures position of –65,123 contracts. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) were marginally net sellers (‑196.93 cr). Sector breadth shows “LEADING” groups such as PSU banks, capital markets and consumption, while “WEAKENING” is limited to infrastructure. Options data point to a Nifty max‑pain level at 25,400, with a call wall at the same level and a put wall at 25,350; the expected range is 25,376‑25,398. Bank Nifty options show a max‑pain at 60,000, call wall at 58,000 and put wall at 57,000.

Watch the Nifty pivot points (S1 25,269.35, P 25,385.35, R1 25,503.4) and Bank Nifty’s support at 61,693.43 and resistance at 62,067.82. Key headlines to monitor include FII inflows supporting banking stocks, SEBI’s lower commodity margins, and the RBI’s overnight variable‑rate reverse repo auction on Nov 18, which could affect liquidity and the INR‑US Dollar rate (currently 93.46). Keep an eye on the 25,500 level, a psychological barrier noted in several market outlooks.
